app.name: Kamgar Compass
welcome.eyebrow: A clearer picture of work and funding
welcome.headline: Every grant pays for the work. Who pays for the worker's rights?
welcome.description: For organisations and NGOs, see which labour obligations may apply and the hidden cost of employing people. Understand how much of the real staff cost the budget leaves uncovered, and what may happen when funding ends.
welcome.featuresLabel: What Kamgar Compass helps you do
welcome.disclaimer: Informational tool only. Not legal advice.

language.label: Language
worker.title: Understand the rules that shape your work
worker.intro: A clear starting point for understanding employment rules and the costs behind a job. Choose a language to read the Worker view in.
worker.sectionTitle: A simple guide to the rules
worker.sectionIntro: These short explanations are a starting point. What applies can depend on your work, employer and the rules in force.
funder.title: Plan for the full cost of employing people
funder.intro: Use this pack as a conversation starter when planning staff budgets. Select a language for the Funder Pack independently of the Worker view.
funder.sectionIntro: Before setting a budget, identify the rules that may apply and confirm the details with a qualified adviser.
funder.cardBody: Include salary and any employment-related contributions or benefits that apply. Check the current rules for each worker and location before finalising figures.
notice.disclaimer: General information only. This guide does not decide which laws apply to a particular person or organisation, calculate statutory contributions, or replace legal advice.
app.tagline: See the staff costs your grant may leave uncovered.
app.heroNote: An indicative planning tool for Indian NGOs. Legal values are unverified estimates; confirm them before acting.

view.workerIntro: Choose a role to review possible protections and questions to raise. These signals are not a legal decision.
worker.askEmployer: You could ask: "Which employment protections apply to my work, and where can I read the current written policy?"
worker.missingInformation: Some protection details cannot be confirmed with the current project data. Ask your organisation or a qualified adviser.

validation.startMonth: Enter a month from 1 to one month after the grant ends.
validation.endMonth: End month must be on or after the start month and within the grant or one month after.
